segments.text: This is TodoMVC, a small to-do list app. In this short demo we'll add three tasks, complete one of them, and filter the list.
We type each task into the box at the top and press Enter. Here are three tasks for the week: buy groceries, write the project README, and book a dentist appointment.
The README is finished, so we tick its checkbox. The task is crossed out, and the counter at the bottom now shows two items left.
The filters at the bottom choose what the list shows. Active shows only the tasks still to do, and Completed shows the finished ones.
Back on All, every task is listed again. That's the whole workflow: add, complete and filter.
